title: How long does the heater run?
hook: Change time and predict electrical energy dissipated.
misconception: electrical energy dissipated stays fixed when time doubles.
objective: Apply E = Pt to compare electrical energy dissipated when time changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal resistor at fixed power, E = Pt. When time doubles, electrical energy dissipated becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model E = Pt; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal resistor at fixed power, with a nonzero initial result. If time triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on electrical energy dissipated?
recall.why: Apply E = Pt under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
